name: sedan-drive
description: Procedural three.js sedan you can drive on a test track or through any real place built from OpenStreetMap.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp *.html *.js package.json dist/ && cp -r vendor models textures dist/
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx --yes serve@14.2.4 -l 5174 dist
scripts.proxy:kv: cd proxy && npx --yes wrangler@4.159.0 kv namespace create AREAS --update-config
